reproduction.method: Training-only stratified 3-fold selection: linear L2 softmax, Gaussian NB, RBF kernel ridge, RBF SVM (SMO)
reproduction.description: Compare measured test errors and fitted complexity on generated nonlinear rings and three-class Gaussian data.
differences: Synthetic data replace all six benchmark datasets.
A bounded 2×2 kernel grid replaces the original hours-long 5-fold search.
RVM and sparse multinomial kernel regression are not implemented or scored; actual alternatives are named.
No original timing, sparsity, or accuracy claims.

metrics.selection: 3-fold joint gamma/lambda CV for nonlinear models; lambda CV for linear/NB
